title: Pieces of the Puzzle
text:
*You piece together what you've found so far. The missing merchants, the ransacked shop, the guard captain's frustrations — it all points in one direction. Someone powerful is running an operation through Ashenmoor, and they're eliminating anyone who gets too close.*

*The shipping manifest fragment you found in Aldric's shop lists goods routed through the Merchants' Guild harbor offices. Harren's name appears as the authorizing signature on every shipment.*

*But knowing and proving are two different things. You need more evidence, or allies who can help you get it.*

choices.text: Take your findings to the Duke's estate
Visit the Temple — the priests hear many confessions
Check the city archives for shipping records
